groups.title: water 氵 and ice 冫

chars.story: Water gathering at the tip until it falls: drip.
chars.note: Also counts drops: 一滴水.

chars.story: Still water that shines pale: a lake.
chars.note: Also 'to moor' a boat. Mostly 湖泊 'lakes'; a literary 'lake'.

chars.story: Water in a hollow where you wash yourself: bathe.
Water only a little deep: shallow.
chars.note: Traditional 淺 has 戔 where 戋 is now.

chars.story: Water turning to ice, and a cold that seizes you: freeze.
chars.note: Traditional 凍.

chars.story: Water poured into a ditch to feed the fields: irrigate.
Water running over its banks: overflowing.
chars.note: Traditional 濫.

chars.story: A throat crying out for water: thirsty.
Water running clear and fast; eyes running over a page.
chars.note: Meets it only in 浏览 'to browse'. Traditional 瀏.

chars.parts: 氵 water + 爫 claw + 壬
chars.story: Water soaking in everywhere, too much of it: lewd.
Hands bent over, digging into the ground: dig out.
A hand picks fruit from a branch: pluck.
A hand setting words down in order: compose.
A hand reaching out to lift someone up: save.
chars.note: Mostly only in 拯救 'to rescue'.

chars.story: A mouth calling someone over: call over.
chars.note: Traditional 喚.

chars.parts: 礻 altar + 寿 long life (sound)
chars.story: At the altar, asking for long life: a prayer.
chars.note: Traditional 禱.

chars.story: A hand and some strength nudging someone toward good sense: advise.
chars.note: Traditional 勸.

chars.story: Far too many mouths going at once, not a few: noisy.
Words that suit each other, spoken between friends: friendship.
chars.note: Traditional 誼: 訁 on the left became 讠.

chars.story: Words argued out in public: litigation.
chars.note: Traditional 訟: 訁 became 讠.

chars.story: Careful words with nothing rash in them: cautious.
chars.note: Traditional 謹: 訁 became 讠.

chars.story: Words slipped in suddenly to trick you: swindle.
chars.note: Traditional 詐: 訁 became 讠.

chars.story: A metal vessel set over the fire: pot.
chars.note: Traditional 鍋: 金 became 钅.

chars.story: Fire behind a little door: stove.
chars.note: Traditional 爐.

chars.story: Food pressed together flat: a flat cake.
chars.note: Traditional 餅: 食 became 饣.

chars.story: A bundle of stinging flavour: spicy.
Clay dug from a mound and fired into jars: pottery.
chars.note: 陶醉 'be intoxicated with'. Also a surname.

chars.parts: 丷 + 口 mouth + 儿 legs
chars.story: A mouth over two legs, handing something across: cash in.
chars.note: Traditional 兌.

chars.story: A person bowing down, short of something: owe.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'yawn'. Modern use is 'owe, lack'.

chars.story: A gift of shells added to the greeting: congratulate.
chars.note: Traditional 賀.

chars.story: Shells passed across as a gift: give as a gift.
chars.note: Traditional 贈.

chars.story: A horse with its head held high: proud.
chars.note: Traditional 驕: 馬 became 马.

chars.story: Head raised toward the sun: hold high.
A heart that wants it exactly right: careful.
A sheep too shy to be seen looking ugly: shy.
The heart replays it each time: repent.
chars.note: 后悔 'regret' is the usual word.

chars.story: Flesh piled up past half: plump.
A thin skin of flesh: membrane.
The flesh in the middle of the body: waist.
The flesh shaped like a door-frame: shoulder.
You point at your nose to say 'me', with a grid beneath: nose.
Eyes shut like everyone's at night: sleep.
chars.note: Formal 'sleep': 睡眠, 失眠 'insomnia'; 睡 is the everyday verb.

chars.story: An eye that is lost: blind.

chars.parts: - a mouth of teeth with 止 on top
chars.story: A row of teeth in a jaw.
chars.note: Traditional 齒. The literary 'tooth': 牙齿 'teeth', 齿轮 'gear'.

chars.story: The animal everyone looks up to: lion.
chars.note: Traditional 獅.

chars.story: A creeping creature, an 'it' you step round: snake.

chars.parts: 宀 roof + 必 (sound) + 虫 insect
chars.story: Insects in their roofed hive make honey.
Outsiders treated as no better than insects: barbarian.
chars.note: Colloquially 'quite': 蛮好. Traditional 蠻.

chars.story: A mountain stretched out in a long line: ridge.
chars.note: Traditional 嶺.

chars.story: A small mountain standing in the sea: islet.
chars.note: Traditional 嶼. Almost only in 岛屿.

chars.parts: 山 mountain + 幺 thread + 幺 thread
chars.story: Hidden in the hills behind a veil of threads: secluded.
chars.note: 幽默 'humour' is the commonest word.

chars.story: A gate thrown wide open: broad.
chars.note: Traditional 闊: 門 became 门.

chars.story: The high roof of a vast hall: magnificent.
A dragon sheltering under a vast roof: huge.
chars.note: Traditional 龐. Almost only in 庞大 'huge'; also 面庞 'face'.

chars.story: A head as big as a boulder: large.
chars.note: Traditional 碩: 頁 became 页.

chars.parts: 乃 + 又 hand + 皿 dish
chars.story: A hand and a dish filled to the brim: filled.
A bow drawn full across its whole span: fill up.
chars.note: Traditional 彌.

chars.story: Grain so thin you can only hope: sparse.
Feet and water spreading out until things thin out.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'distant'. 疏远 'drift apart'.

chars.story: The light off an army's bright banners: radiance.
chars.note: Traditional 輝.

chars.story: Laid open under a fierce sun: expose to sun.
chars.note: Only used in a few words like 曝光.

chars.story: Rain-like water hanging in the air: fog.
chars.note: Traditional 霧.

chars.story: Small bits of earth floating: dust.
chars.note: Traditional 塵. The common written 'dust': 灰尘, 尘土.

chars.parts: 舟 boat + 叟 old man (sound)
chars.story: A boat, and the word for counting boats: one 艘, two 艘.
chars.note: Only a counter: 一艘船 'one ship'.

chars.story: Little pieces of wood, counted one by one.
chars.note: Counts coins, badges, rings.

chars.parts: 几 a spray + 木 tree
chars.story: A spray of blossom hanging from the tree.
chars.note: Counts flowers and clouds: 一朵花.

chars.story: A box with legs under it, a horse in its stall: the horse counter.
chars.note: Counts horses: 一匹马.

chars.story: Two rings threaded on one stick: a string.
chars.note: Counts strings of things: 一串钥匙.

chars.story: One grain of rice standing on its own: grain.
The scent of grass spreading out: fragrance.
chars.note: Common in girls' names and 芬兰 'Finland'.

chars.story: People following close behind each other: a cluster.
chars.note: Traditional 叢.

chars.parts: 木 tree + 帛 silk cloth
chars.story: The plant that gives soft cloth: cotton.
A long stick of wood: pole.
chars.note: Traditional 桿.

chars.story: Thread twisted into cloth: spin.
chars.note: Traditional 紡: 糸 became 纟.

chars.story: A cloth covering the head: hat.
A hand pulls cloth over like a skin: drape.
Grain pounded by two hands: the farming state of Qin.
chars.note: The Qin dynasty, and a surname.

chars.story: A surname, as in 蒋介石 Chiang Kai-shek.
chars.note: A surname (Jiang). Traditional 蔣.

chars.parts: - a hide stretched and tied, two strokes beside it
chars.story: A soft hide, tied.
chars.note: Mostly a surname (Wei) or in transliterations. Traditional 韋.

chars.story: Water with a weight in it, sinking: the old form of 沉, now the surname Shen.
chars.note: Surname Shen. The same character as 沉 in older writing.

chars.story: A woman radical in a girl's name.
chars.note: Used in girls' names and foreign names such as 安妮 'Annie'.

chars.story: A stringed zither: harp.
chars.note: Also in foreign names: 亚瑟 'Arthur'.

chars.story: Walks away and breaks off from us: pass away.
chars.note: His Analects card: 'flow past'. Modern use also 'die', politely.

chars.story: Walking past the line: go beyond.
A foot sends it flying: kick.
A dragon kept safe under a roof: pamper.
chars.note: Traditional 寵.

chars.story: A cave-like hollow where an animal curls up: nest.
chars.note: Traditional 窩.

chars.story: Rites gone wrong at the altar: misfortune.
chars.note: Traditional 禍.

chars.story: A tiger's claw tearing at its prey: brutal.
A mountain breaking into pieces: collapse.
Water bursting through a dam: break through.
chars.note: Traditional 潰.

chars.story: A big man pressed between two small ones: sandwich.
chars.note: Traditional 夾.

chars.story: A mouth that speaks of itself: I, my.
chars.note: Same as in the Analects, but only in literary phrases in modern prose.

chars.story: A head tilted to one side, leaning a lot: considerably.

words.g: to have quite a bit of

chars.note: Traditional 頗.

chars.parts: 士 + 冖 cover + 几 table
chars.story: A hard lid over a soft inside: casing.
chars.note: Traditional 殼.

chars.parts: 辛 bitter + 刂 knife + 辛 bitter
chars.story: A knife between two look-alikes: tell them apart.
Grain stacked in rows so none is lost: rank, order.
A stone slab standing upright: monument.
A person who steps in where others are squeezed: knight-errant.
chars.note: Traditional 俠.

chars.parts: 亻 person + 吕 two linked rings
chars.story: Two people linked side by side: companion.
chars.note: Traditional 侶. Only in 伴侣 'partner', a literary 'companion'.

sentences.en: I bear in mind that misfortunes never come singly.
The lion is the king of the jungle.
I've been careful my whole life.
Drop by drop, the water can conglomerate into a lake.

sentences.zh: 一艘船突然从雾中出现。
sentences.en: A boat suddenly appeared out of the mist.

sentences.zh: 越来越多的情侣出国度蜜月。
sentences.en: More and more couples go on honeymoon trips abroad.

sentences.zh: 地上覆盖着积雪，冻成了又硬又厚的壳。
sentences.en: The snow lay on the ground, frozen into a thick, hard crust.

sentences.zh: 后来我知道了，蛇是没有用来听声音的耳朵的。
sentences.en: Then I was made aware that snakes have no ears with which to hear.
